policy.purpose: Release-time regression evidence for bundled or materially adapted OSS donor behavior.
policy.upstreamUpdateRule: No upstream SHA may change without license review, imported/adapted path review, relevant regression tests, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES reconciliation, and a human-readable change note.
policy.pathBase: All destinationPaths and regressionEvidence are relative to the LiOS src/ directory; corresponding component destinationPaths use the same src-relative strings.
policy.evidenceMeaning: Listed paths identify existing regression coverage/lineage, not executed PASS results. Historical blueprint smoke evidence is bounded to its recorded target; no release or SP acceptance is inferred. Exact-head outcomes and real MSJ/target/regression evidence remain required.

entries.lineage: components.json importedPaths/destinationPaths/modifications is the exact source-to-destination authority; destinationPaths include both source imports and explicitly identified LiOS-owned consumers/pattern adaptations. GM-13 imports the pinned acp-core helpers; SI-02 L5 imports retry timing; SI-02.15 adapts placement binding; SI-02.14 imports CUA policy/helpers. SI-02.13 directly imports the pinned browser bounded-UTF8 diagnostic helper and ports its test, while server/browserRuntimePack.ts is a LiOS-owned consumer/pattern adaptation, not a donor byte copy. Its isolated worker/stdio/P13 broker path adapts pinned browser lifecycle, page ownership, interception and transport mechanics. Donor browser control/profile/auth/plugin authorities and host/raw-network launch paths are not imported. Earlier utility, Gateway/device and GM-10 mappings remain in components.json. Listed coverage is authored lineage, not an executed PASS or Shipping Point claim.
entries.authorityBoundary: ACP helpers bind only to admitted GM-11 runs; timing authorizes no retry; placement cannot mint authority or fall back to ambient host; CUA assessment does not execute. The browser transport executes only an exact prepared plan in a physically deny-network container, with BrowserConnectorPolicy and P13 DNS-pinned host fetches. `agent.browser.navigate` uses the existing governed registry and exact server-held approval. No browser runtime image is qualified by this record; missing in-image Node/playwright-core/Chromium fails closed, and native GUI execution remains unavailable.
